title: D109（周四）：每一步的Trace与审计
html:
D109（周四）：每一步的Trace与审计

S5 Agent · W16 · 2小时。前置：D108-三种预算与停止条件及前一天面试题。只在验证工程给出参考实现，用户练习代码由你自己手写。

本章要加一张表，迁移步骤同 D106—D107（--create-only 后手工补 CHECK，再 migrate deploy 与 db:generate）。

今天要做出什么

给每一步补上可排查的证据：新增 agent_traces（一步一条，stepId 唯一），存这一步实际发给模型或工具的输入、拿回的输出、分项 token 和耗时。写入前先脱敏再截断（复用 D19 的规则），截断按码点并把省略提示算进列宽。运行结束后写一条 agent.run_finished 审计进工单的审计时间线（D18），after 里带状态、停止原因、步数与 token 汇总。Trace 只给运行的发起人，通过 GET /api/agent/runs/:id/traces 读，正文不进事件。

时间安排（120分钟）

回忆10、知识35、动手55、自检与提交20。到100分钟先砍拓展与选做，保留必做契约和两反证；完整回归等待另计。

零、闭卷回忆

先回答再展开；前三题按昨天、3天前、7天前复习。复测错题本到期项；尚无用户提交，不登记已掌握。

1. D108：预算检查为什么放在开步之前，用 >= 而不是 >？

答案

已经走了 8 步、上限 8 时就不该再开第 9 步。放到之后或用 > 会多走一步，反证实测到了。

2. D107：Trace 之外，为什么事件载荷要限制成扁平对象？

答案

事件要全量读出来回放；带嵌套长文本会让它变成第二个数据模型，查询和回放都变慢。

3. D19：日志脱敏为什么写成集中的规则，而不是各处自己处理？

答案

规则集中才能保证新增的接口、日志、异常信息都走同一份；分散写必然有地方漏。

一、知识点与推导

示例取自当天通过的测试，完整文件（含导入与夹具）见第四节。

1.1 Trace 单独一张表，和事件分工

事件（D107）回答「发生了什么」，载荷是扁平的结构化字段；Trace 回答「这一步到底发给谁、拿回什么」，存的是文本。两者必须分开：事件要小、要能全量读出来做回放；Trace 大、只在排查时按需读。表上 stepId @unique——一步最多一条 Trace，重复写入说明调用方把同一步记了两次（捕获唯一约束报 RUN_TRACE_DUPLICATE）。字段只有必要的几项：kind（model/tool）、input、output（各 2000 字符）、分项 token、耗时、truncated 标记、requestId（串起同一请求的日志与审计，复用 D41 的请求上下文）。

可运行示例：先脱敏再截断：手机号、令牌、口令哈希都不会留半截

来源：apps/server/src/agent/run-trace.spec.ts。

  it('先脱敏再截断：手机号、令牌、口令哈希都不会留半截', () => {
    const text = '联系人 13800000001，Bearer aaa.bbb.ccc，口令 scrypt$16384$8$1$abcdef';
    const { text: masked, truncated } = prepareField(text);
    expect(truncated).toBe(false);
    expect(masked).toContain('138****0001');
    expect(masked).toContain('Bearer [已隐藏]');
    expect(masked).toContain('scrypt$[已隐藏]');
    expect(masked).not.toContain('13800000001');
    expect(masked).not.toContain('aaa.bbb.ccc');
    // 截断发生在脱敏之后：先截断会把手机号切成明文片段
    const long = '联系人 13800000001；'.repeat(200);
    const result = prepareField(long, 40);
    expect(result.truncated).toBe(true);
    expect(result.text).toContain('138****0001');
    expect(result.text).not.toMatch(/\d{11}/);
  });

在 apps/server 运行：

pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/run-trace.spec.ts -t "先脱敏再截断：手机号、令牌、口令哈希都不会留半截"

推导题：为什么不把模型输入输出直接塞进事件的 payload？

答案

事件要全量读出来回放，带上几 KB 文本后列表接口和回放都会变慢；而且事件载荷被刻意限制成扁平结构（D107），塞长文本就破坏了那个约定。

1.2 顺序很重要：先脱敏，再截断

prepareField 做两件事，顺序不能反：先 redactForLog（D19 的规则：手机号 → 138****0001、Bearer xxx.yyy.zzz → Bearer [已隐藏]、scrypt$... → scrypt$[已隐藏]），再按码点截断。反过来做的后果是：截断可能把 13800000001 切成 138000，脱敏规则（\b1\d{10}\b）不再匹配，于是半截明文手机号就留在库里了。反证 A 去掉脱敏，断言立刻失败。截断按 Array.from 的码点切，不会把表情或汉字切成半个字符。

可运行示例：超长按码点截断并标注省略数量

来源：apps/server/src/agent/run-trace.spec.ts。

  it('超长按码点截断并标注省略数量', () => {
    const emoji = '😀'.repeat(TRACE_FIELD_LIMIT + 5);
    const { text, truncated } = prepareField(emoji);
    expect(truncated).toBe(true);
    // 总长度不超过列宽：省略提示也算在 limit 里面
    expect(Array.from(text)).toHaveLength(TRACE_FIELD_LIMIT);
    expect(text.endsWith('…（省略 5 个字符）')).toBe(true);
    // 不切断代理对：保留下来的每个码点都仍是完整的表情
    const kept = text.slice(0, text.indexOf('…'));
    expect(Array.from(kept).every(point => point === '😀')).toBe(true);
    const exact = prepareField('一'.repeat(TRACE_FIELD_LIMIT));
    expect(exact.truncated).toBe(false);
  });

在 apps/server 运行：

pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/run-trace.spec.ts -t "超长按码点截断并标注省略数量"

推导题：为什么不在前端或日志收集端做脱敏？

答案

那是最后一道，不是第一道。数据一旦落库就可能被导出、被别的接口读到；脱敏必须发生在写入之前。

1.3 截断上限要算上省略提示

本章踩过一次：列是 VARCHAR(2000)，我按 2000 个码点截断后又追加了「…（省略 N 个字符）」，总长度超过 2000，Postgres 直接报 value too long。修正是把省略提示算进上限：kept = limit - suffix 长度，入库后总长度正好不超过列宽。教训：截断上限的口径要和存储上限一致，提示语、引号、包装字段都要算进去。另外 Postgres 的 VARCHAR(n) 按字符（码点）计数，和 Array.from().length 一致，所以两边口径能对上；如果列是按字节算的类型，就要换成字节口径。

可运行示例：每一步一条 Trace，用量可汇总，手机号已脱敏

来源：apps/server/test/agent-trace.e2e-spec.ts。

  it('每一步一条 Trace，用量可汇总，手机号已脱敏', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    const { usage } = await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const rows = await traces.list(run.id);
    expect(rows.map(row => [row.ordinal, row.kind])).toEqual([[1, 'tool'], [2, 'model']]);
    expect(rows[0]!.output).toContain('138****0001');
    expect(rows[0]!.output).not.toContain('13800000001');
    expect(usage).toMatchObject({ inputTokens: 190, outputTokens: 130, traces: 2, truncated: false });
    expect(usage.durationMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    // 事件里只有结构化摘要，没有 Trace 正文
    const events = await journal.events(run.id);
    expect(JSON.stringify(events)).not.toContain('系统提示词');
  });

pnpm exec vitest run --config ./vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-trace.e2e-spec.ts -t "每一步一条 Trace，用量可汇总，手机号已脱敏"

推导题：为什么不把列宽放大到 4000 就不用算这些了？

答案

放大只是把问题推后：真正要确定的是「一条 Trace 最多存多长」。定好上限后，截断、提示、列宽三者必须一致，否则总有一次会撞上限。

1.4 运行结束写一条审计，进既有时间线

运行完成后写一条 AuditLog（D18）：action 是 agent.run_finished，entityType/entityKey 用工单，所以它出现在工单的审计时间线里，和人工操作并列——运维查一张工单时能看到「谁让 Agent 跑过、结果如何」。before 放目标与预算，after 放状态、停止原因、步数和分项 token。注意审计表是只追加的：D18 用触发器禁止 UPDATE/DELETE，所以测试的清理代码不能删它（本章踩过，报 audit_logs 只能追加），隔离测试库靠 global-setup 重建。Trace 接口只给运行的发起人，别人查返回 404（和 D106 的归属判断一致）。

可运行示例：运行结束写入审计，进的是工单的审计时间线

来源：apps/server/test/agent-trace.e2e-spec.ts。

  it('运行结束写入审计，进的是工单的审计时间线', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const logs = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { entityKey: ticketNo, action: 'agent.run_finished' },
      orderBy: { occurredAt: 'desc' }, take: 1 });
    expect(logs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(logs[0]).toMatchObject({ actorUsername: 'bob', entityType: 'ticket' });
    expect(logs[0]!.before).toMatchObject({ runId: run.id, goal: '定位远程登录失败' });
    expect(logs[0]!.after).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', stopReason: 'answered', steps: 2,
      inputTokens: 190, outputTokens: 130, traces: 2 });
    // 工单审计接口能看到这条记录（沿用 D18 的权限与路由）
    const timeline = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}/audit-logs`)
      .set('authorization', auth('carol')).expect(200);
    expect(timeline.body.data.some((item: { action: string }) => item.action === 'agent.run_finished')).toBe(true);
  });

在 apps/server 运行：

pnpm exec vitest run --config ./vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-trace.e2e-spec.ts -t "运行结束写入审计，进的是工单的审计时间线"

推导题：审计里为什么只放汇总，不放 Trace 正文？

答案

审计是长期保留的法律/合规记录，要小且稳定；正文属于排查材料，保留期更短。把两者混在一起，清理 Trace 时会连带动审计。

二、自己动手（必做）

步骤1：建 Trace 表

提示1：方向

一步一条（stepId 唯一），字段只留必要项，取值与非负在库里也约束一次。

提示2：API与文档位置

Prisma 的 @unique、onDelete: Cascade；CHECK 手工补在迁移末尾；记得删掉 Prisma 重建无关外键的语句。

提示3：伪代码

agent_traces: stepId @unique、ordinal、kind、input/output VARCHAR(2000)、inputTokens/outputTokens/durationMs、truncated、requestId CHECK: kind ∈ (model, tool)；三个计数 >= 0；ordinal >= 1

步骤2：写字段处理函数

提示1：方向

先脱敏再截断；上限包含省略提示；按码点切。

提示2：API与文档位置

复用 redactForLog（D19）；Array.from 取码点；返回 { text, truncated }。

提示3：伪代码

prepareField(value, limit): redacted = redactForLog(value) 码点 <= limit → 原样返回 omitted = 码点 - limit；suffix = …（省略 N 个字符） kept = limit - suffix 码点数；返回前 kept 个码点 + suffix，truncated = true

步骤3：接到执行器

提示1：方向

每一步在 beginStep 之后、endStep 之前写 Trace；运行收尾写审计。

提示2：API与文档位置

StepOutcome.trace 可选字段；AuditService.record 需要事务；currentRequestId() 取请求 ID。

提示3：伪代码

onStep: beginStep → outcome.trace 存在则 traces.record(...) → endStep 收尾: finish(reason) → traces.usage(runId) 汇总 → record(run_finished) → audit.record(agent.run_finished)

步骤4：接口与权限

提示1：方向

Trace 只给发起人；出站用 zod 收紧；用量和明细一起返回。

提示2：API与文档位置

GET /api/agent/runs/:id/traces；tracePageSchema；归属判断复用 runs.get(user, id)。

提示3：伪代码

traceList: runs.get(user, id)（别人的 → 404）→ traces.list → 逐条 traceViewSchema.parse → 加上 usage 汇总

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { redactForLog } from '../common/sensitive.js';
import { currentRequestId } from '../common/request-context.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';

export const TRACE_FIELD_LIMIT = 2000;
export type TraceKind = 'model' | 'tool';
export interface TraceInput {
  stepId: string;
  ordinal: number;
  kind: TraceKind;
  input: string;
  output: string;
  inputTokens?: number;
  outputTokens?: number;
  durationMs?: number;
}

// 先脱敏再截断：顺序反了会把一半的手机号或令牌留在文本里。
// limit 是入库后的总长度上限（列是 VARCHAR(2000)，按字符计），所以省略提示也要算进去。
export function prepareField(value: string, limit = TRACE_FIELD_LIMIT) {
  const redacted = redactForLog(typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value));
  const points = Array.from(redacted);
  if (points.length <= limit) return { text: redacted, truncated: false };
  const omitted = points.length - limit;
  const suffix = `…（省略 ${omitted} 个字符）`;
  const kept = Math.max(0, limit - Array.from(suffix).length);
  // 按码点截断，不切断表情或汉字。
  return { text: points.slice(0, kept).join('') + suffix, truncated: true };
}

const counts = (value: number | undefined) => {
  if (value === undefined) return 0;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new RunFailure('RUN_TRACE_INVALID');
  return value;
};

@Injectable()
export class RunTraceService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService) {}

  // 一步最多一条 Trace（stepId 唯一）：重复写入说明调用方把同一步记了两次。
  async record(runId: string, trace: TraceInput) {
    if (trace.kind !== 'model' && trace.kind !== 'tool') throw new RunFailure('RUN_TRACE_INVALID');
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(trace.ordinal) || trace.ordinal < 1) throw new RunFailure('RUN_TRACE_INVALID');
    const input = prepareField(trace.input);
    const output = prepareField(trace.output);
    try {
      return await this.db.agentTrace.create({
        data: {
          runId, stepId: trace.stepId, ordinal: trace.ordinal, kind: trace.kind,
          input: input.text, output: output.text,
          inputTokens: counts(trace.inputTokens), outputTokens: counts(trace.outputTokens),
          durationMs: counts(trace.durationMs),
          truncated: input.truncated || output.truncated,
          requestId: currentRequestId() ?? null,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('agent_traces_step_id_key')) {
        throw new RunFailure('RUN_TRACE_DUPLICATE');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async list(runId: string) {
    return this.db.agentTrace.findMany({ where: { runId }, orderBy: { ordinal: 'asc' }, take: 8 });
  }

  // 用量汇总：供 run_finished 事件与审计使用，不重新解析正文。
  async usage(runId: string) {
    const rows = await this.list(runId);
    return rows.reduce((total, row) => ({
      inputTokens: total.inputTokens + row.inputTokens,
      outputTokens: total.outputTokens + row.outputTokens,
      durationMs: total.durationMs + row.durationMs,
      traces: total.traces + 1,
      truncated: total.truncated || row.truncated,
    }), { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, durationMs: 0, traces: 0, truncated: false });
  }
}

    expect(truncated).toBe(true);

import { exhausted, stepDeadlineMs, type RunBudget, type RunSpend } from './run-budget.js';
import type { StepPhase } from './agent-journal.service.js';
import type { StopReason } from './run-state.js';

export interface StepRequest { ordinal: number; deadlineMs: number; spend: RunSpend; }
export interface StepOutcome {
  phase: StepPhase;
  summary: string;
  tokens: number;
  // Trace 用：这一步实际发给模型/工具的内容与拿回的结果，以及分项用量。
  trace?: { kind: 'model' | 'tool'; input: string; output: string; inputTokens?: number; outputTokens?: number };
  // answer 非空表示本步给出了最终答案，循环就此结束。
  answer?: string;
  failure?: string;
}
export interface LoopHooks {
  budget: RunBudget;
  now?: () => number;
  think: (request: StepRequest) => Promise<StepOutcome>;
  onStep: (outcome: StepOutcome, request: StepRequest) => Promise<void>;
}
export interface LoopResult { reason: StopReason; spend: RunSpend; answer: string | null; }

// 推理-行动循环：每一步之前检查三种预算，任何一项用完就停并给出原因。
// 这里不碰数据库，也不认识模型：think 由调用方注入（测试注入假实现，D111 注入真实链路）。
export async function runLoop(hooks: LoopHooks): Promise<LoopResult> {
  const now = hooks.now ?? (() => Date.now());
  const startedAt = now();
  const spend: RunSpend = { steps: 0, elapsedMs: 0, tokens: 0 };
  for (;;) {
    spend.elapsedMs = now() - startedAt;
    const stop = exhausted(hooks.budget, spend);
    if (stop) return { reason: stop, spend, answer: null };
    const request: StepRequest = {
      ordinal: spend.steps + 1,
      deadlineMs: stepDeadlineMs(hooks.budget, spend),
      spend: { ...spend },
    };
    let outcome: StepOutcome;
    try {
      outcome = await hooks.think(request);
    } catch (error) {
      // 单步异常也要先记账：这一步已经发生过，步数和耗时都算。
      spend.steps += 1;
      spend.elapsedMs = now() - startedAt;
      await hooks.onStep({ phase: 'plan', summary: '单步异常', tokens: 0,
        failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'STEP_FAILED' }, request);
      return { reason: 'model_failed', spend, answer: null };
    }
    spend.steps += 1;
    spend.tokens += Math.max(0, Math.trunc(outcome.tokens));
    spend.elapsedMs = now() - startedAt;
    await hooks.onStep(outcome, request);
    if (outcome.failure) return { reason: 'tool_failed', spend, answer: null };
    if (outcome.answer) return { reason: 'answered', spend, answer: outcome.answer };
  }
}

    const claimed = await this.runs.claim(user, runId, (await this.runs.get(user, runId)).version);
    await this.journal.record(claimed.id, 'run_started',
      { ticketNo: claimed.ticketNo, maxSteps: limits.maxSteps, maxMs: limits.maxMs, maxTokens: limits.maxTokens });
    const context = { ticketNo: claimed.ticketNo, goal: claimed.goal };
    const result = await runLoop({
      budget: limits,
      think: request => think(request, context),
      onStep: async (outcome, request) => {
        const startedAt = Date.now();
        const { step } = await this.journal.beginStep(claimed.id, outcome.phase, outcome.summary);
        if (step.ordinal !== request.ordinal) throw new RunFailure('RUN_STEP_ORDINAL_MISMATCH');
        if (outcome.trace) {
          // Trace 与步骤一一对应；内容先脱敏再截断，正文不进事件。
          await this.traces.record(claimed.id, {
            stepId: step.id, ordinal: step.ordinal, kind: outcome.trace.kind,
            input: outcome.trace.input, output: outcome.trace.output,
            inputTokens: outcome.trace.inputTokens, outputTokens: outcome.trace.outputTokens,
            durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
          });
        }
        await this.journal.endStep(step.id, outcome.failure
          ? { status: 'failed', errorCode: outcome.failure }
          : { status: 'succeeded' });
      },
    });
    const current = await this.runs.get(user, runId);
    const finished = await this.runs.finish(current.id, current.version, result.reason);
    const usage = await this.traces.usage(finished.id);
    await this.journal.record(finished.id, 'run_finished',
      { stopReason: result.reason, steps: result.spend.steps, tokens: result.spend.tokens,
        elapsedMs: Math.trunc(result.spend.elapsedMs), answer: result.answer });
    // 审计进既有的工单时间线（D18）：谁、对哪张工单、跑出什么结果，和业务操作同一张表。
    await this.db.$transaction(tx => this.audit.record(tx, {
      actorId: user.id, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.run_finished',
      entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: finished.ticketNo,
      before: { runId: finished.id, goal: finished.goal, maxSteps: limits.maxSteps },
      after: { status: finished.status, stopReason: result.reason, steps: result.spend.steps,
        inputTokens: usage.inputTokens, outputTokens: usage.outputTokens, traces: usage.traces },
    }));
    return { run: finished, result, usage };
  }
}

import { Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, HttpException, Param, Post, Query } from '@nestjs/common';
import { eventPageSchema, eventViewSchema, runDetailSchema, runListSchema, runStartSchema, runVersionSchema,
  runViewSchema, stepViewSchema, tracePageSchema, traceViewSchema } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { AgentRunsService } from './agent-runs.service.js';
import { AgentJournalService } from './agent-journal.service.js';
import { RunTraceService } from './run-trace.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';
import { RunStateError } from './run-state.js';
import { z } from 'zod';

type RunRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentRunsService['get']>>;
type StepRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['steps']>>[number];
type EventRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['events']>>[number];

export function stepView(step: StepRow) {
  return stepViewSchema.parse({
    id: step.id, ordinal: step.ordinal, phase: step.phase, status: step.status, summary: step.summary,
    errorCode: step.errorCode, startedAt: step.startedAt.toISOString(),
    endedAt: step.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 事件对外只给序号、类型、所属步序和扁平载荷；不暴露内部主键。
export function eventView(event: EventRow, stepOrdinal: number | null) {
  return eventViewSchema.parse({
    seq: event.seq, type: event.type, stepOrdinal,
    payload: event.payload ?? {}, createdAt: event.createdAt.toISOString(),
  });
}

export function runView(run: RunRow) {
  return runViewSchema.parse({
    id: run.id, ticketNo: run.ticketNo, goal: run.goal, status: run.status, stopReason: run.stopReason,
    version: run.version, stepCount: run.stepCount, createdAt: run.createdAt.toISOString(),
    startedAt: run.startedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, endedAt: run.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 输入问题是 400，看不到是 404，权限变化是 403；状态类问题（转移不允许或被别人改过）都是 409。
export function runHttpStatus(code: string, stateError = false) {
  if (stateError) return 409;
  if (code.endsWith('NOT_FOUND')) return 404;
  if (code === 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID') return 400;
  if (code === 'RUN_SCOPE_CHANGED') return 403;
  return 409;
}

function httpError(error: unknown): never {
  if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
  const known = error instanceof RunFailure || error instanceof RunStateError;
  const code = known ? error.code : 'RUN_FAILED';
  throw new HttpException({ code, message: '运行请求未完成，请查看运行状态后再试' },
    known ? runHttpStatus(code, error instanceof RunStateError) : 503);
}

@Controller('agent/runs')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class AgentRunsController {
  constructor(private readonly runs: AgentRunsService, private readonly journal: AgentJournalService,
    private readonly traces: RunTraceService) {}

  @Post() @HttpCode(201)
  async start(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runStartSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const { run } = await this.runs.start(user, parsed.data);
      return runView(run);
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get()
  async list(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser) {
    try { return runListSchema.parse((await this.runs.list(user)).map(runView)); } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get(':id')
  async detail(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      return runDetailSchema.parse({ run: runView(run), steps: (await this.journal.steps(run.id)).map(stepView) });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 增量拉取：客户端带上已经看到的最大序号，只取后面的事件。
  @Get(':id/events')
  async events(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Query('after') after?: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const parsed = z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).safeParse(after ?? 0);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const steps = await this.journal.steps(run.id);
      const ordinals = new Map(steps.map(step => [step.id, step.ordinal]));
      const events = await this.journal.events(run.id, parsed.data);
      const views = events.map(event => eventView(event, event.stepId ? ordinals.get(event.stepId) ?? null : null));
      return eventPageSchema.parse({ runId: run.id, events: views, lastSeq: views.at(-1)?.seq ?? parsed.data });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // Trace 只给运行的发起人；内容已在写入时脱敏并截断。
  @Get(':id/traces')
  async traceList(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const rows = await this.traces.list(run.id);
      return tracePageSchema.parse({
        runId: run.id,
        traces: rows.map(row => traceViewSchema.parse({
          ordinal: row.ordinal, kind: row.kind, input: row.input, output: row.output,
          inputTokens: row.inputTokens, outputTokens: row.outputTokens,
          durationMs: row.durationMs, truncated: row.truncated,
        })),
        usage: await this.traces.usage(run.id),
      });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/cancel') @HttpCode(200)
  async cancel(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runVersionSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      return runView(await this.runs.cancel(user, id, parsed.data.version));
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }
}

import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';

describe('每一步的 Trace 与审计', () => {
  let app: INestApplication<App>;
  let auth: (name: string) => string;
  let db: PrismaService;
  let runs: AgentRunsService;
  let journal: AgentJournalService;
  let traces: RunTraceService;
  let executor: RunExecutorService;
  let fixtures: TicketFixtures;
  let ticketNo: string;
  let bob: { id: string; username: string; groupId: string | null };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app);
    await app.init();
    auth = await tokenIssuer(app);
    db = app.get(PrismaService);
    runs = app.get(AgentRunsService);
    journal = app.get(AgentJournalService);
    traces = app.get(RunTraceService);
    executor = app.get(RunExecutorService);
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'AGT');
    ticketNo = (await fixtures.create()).ticketNo;
    bob = await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: 'bob' }, select: { id: true, username: true, groupId: true } });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    // 审计表是只追加的（D18 用触发器禁止 UPDATE/DELETE），这里不清理；
    // 隔离测试库由 global-setup 每次重建。
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'AGT' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup();
    await app.close();
  });

  async function queued() {
    const { run } = await runs.start(bob as never, { requestKey: randomUUID(), ticketNo, goal: '定位远程登录失败' });
    return run;
  }
  const think: Think = async request => request.ordinal < 2
    ? { phase: 'tool', summary: '查设备告警', tokens: 120,
        trace: { kind: 'tool', input: JSON.stringify({ tool: 'list_device_alerts', ticketNo }),
          output: '最近 2 条告警：VPN 认证失败；联系人 13800000001', inputTokens: 40, outputTokens: 80 } }
    : { phase: 'answer', summary: '给出处置建议', tokens: 200, answer: '重新绑定动态口令',
        trace: { kind: 'model', input: '系统提示词 + 工单摘要', output: '建议重新绑定动态口令',
          inputTokens: 150, outputTokens: 50 } };

  it('每一步一条 Trace，用量可汇总，手机号已脱敏', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    const { usage } = await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const rows = await traces.list(run.id);
    expect(rows.map(row => [row.ordinal, row.kind])).toEqual([[1, 'tool'], [2, 'model']]);
    expect(rows[0]!.output).toContain('138****0001');
    expect(rows[0]!.output).not.toContain('13800000001');
    expect(usage).toMatchObject({ inputTokens: 190, outputTokens: 130, traces: 2, truncated: false });
    expect(usage.durationMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    // 事件里只有结构化摘要，没有 Trace 正文
    const events = await journal.events(run.id);
    expect(JSON.stringify(events)).not.toContain('系统提示词');
  });

  it('运行结束写入审计，进的是工单的审计时间线', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const logs = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { entityKey: ticketNo, action: 'agent.run_finished' },
      orderBy: { occurredAt: 'desc' }, take: 1 });
    expect(logs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(logs[0]).toMatchObject({ actorUsername: 'bob', entityType: 'ticket' });
    expect(logs[0]!.before).toMatchObject({ runId: run.id, goal: '定位远程登录失败' });
    expect(logs[0]!.after).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', stopReason: 'answered', steps: 2,
      inputTokens: 190, outputTokens: 130, traces: 2 });
    // 工单审计接口能看到这条记录（沿用 D18 的权限与路由）
    const timeline = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}/audit-logs`)
      .set('authorization', auth('carol')).expect(200);
    expect(timeline.body.data.some((item: { action: string }) => item.action === 'agent.run_finished')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('超长内容按码点截断并标记，不影响其他步骤', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, async () => ({
      phase: 'tool', summary: '大结果', tokens: 10, answer: '完成',
      trace: { kind: 'tool', input: '查询', output: '甲'.repeat(2500), inputTokens: 5, outputTokens: 5 },
    }));
    const [row] = await traces.list(run.id);
    expect(row!.truncated).toBe(true);
    expect(row!.output.endsWith('…（省略 500 个字符）')).toBe(true);
    expect(Array.from(row!.output)).toHaveLength(2000);
    const usage = await traces.usage(run.id);
    expect(usage.truncated).toBe(true);
  });

  it('一步只能有一条 Trace，重复写入报冲突', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const [first] = await journal.steps(run.id);
    await expect(traces.record(run.id, { stepId: first!.id, ordinal: 1, kind: 'tool', input: 'x', output: 'y' }))
      .rejects.toThrow('RUN_TRACE_DUPLICATE');
    await expect(traces.record(run.id, { stepId: first!.id, ordinal: 0, kind: 'tool', input: 'x', output: 'y' }))
      .rejects.toThrow('RUN_TRACE_INVALID');
    await expect(traces.record(run.id, { stepId: first!.id, ordinal: 1, kind: 'guess' as never, input: 'x', output: 'y' }))
      .rejects.toThrow('RUN_TRACE_INVALID');
  });

  it('Trace 接口只给本人，内容与用量一致', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const mine = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/agent/runs/${run.id}/traces`)
      .set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(mine.body.data.traces).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(mine.body.data.traces[0]).toMatchObject({ ordinal: 1, kind: 'tool', inputTokens: 40, outputTokens: 80 });
    expect(mine.body.data.usage).toMatchObject({ inputTokens: 190, outputTokens: 130, traces: 2 });
    expect(mine.body.data.traces[0].output).toContain('138****0001');
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/agent/runs/${run.id}/traces`)
      .set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/agent/runs/${run.id}/traces`).expect(401);
  });

  it('数据库拦住非法类型与负数用量；删除 Run 连带删除 Trace', async () => {
    const run = await queued();
    await executor.execute(bob as never, run.id, think);
    const [row] = await traces.list(run.id);
    await expect(db.$executeRaw`UPDATE agent_traces SET kind = 'guess' WHERE id = ${row!.id}::uuid`)
      .rejects.toThrow(/agent_traces_kind_check/);
    await expect(db.$executeRaw`UPDATE agent_traces SET input_tokens = -1 WHERE id = ${row!.id}::uuid`)
      .rejects.toThrow(/agent_traces_tokens_check/);
    await db.agentRun.delete({ where: { id: run.id } });
    expect(await db.agentTrace.count({ where: { runId: run.id } })).toBe(0);
  });
});

  id            String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  occurredAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz

// Outbox（D31）：业务事务里顺手写一行“要发出去的事件”，和业务数据一起提交或一起回滚

model OutboxEvent {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // ticket.assigned、ticket.sla_breached、ticket.sla_escalated
  type        String    @db.VarChar(64)

  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 放进队列的时间；为空表示还没投递
  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at") @db.Timestamptz

  // 投递器每次按创建时间取还没投递的
  @@index([publishedAt, createdAt], map: "outbox_events_unpublished_idx")
  @@map("outbox_events")
}

// 站内通知（D31）：通知 Worker 根据 Outbox 事件生成，D33 推到页面上
model Notification {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // D33：SSE 的持久游标。写入入口先锁用户，再分配序号并提交，避免同一用户提交乱序。
  streamSeq BigInt    @unique @default(autoincrement()) @map("stream_seq")
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  type      String    @db.VarChar(64)
  title     String    @db.VarChar(200)
  ticketNo  String?   @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  // 来自哪个 Outbox 事件：同一个事件给同一个人只生成一条通知，任务重做多少次都一样（D30 的消费者幂等）
  eventId   String    @map("event_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  readAt    DateTime? @map("read_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([eventId, userId], map: "notifications_event_user_unique")
  // 查“我的通知”，按时间倒序
  @@index([userId, createdAt], map: "notifications_user_created_idx")
  @@index([userId, streamSeq], map: "notifications_user_stream_idx")
  @@map("notifications")
}

五、核心面试题

  1. Agent 的可观测要观测到什么粒度？ 要点：到步骤和工具，不只是「一次模型调用」。
  2. Trace 里的敏感信息怎么处理？ 要点：写入前脱敏，而且必须在截断之前。
  3. 截断为什么会撞上数据库列宽？ 要点：因为提示语也占长度。

完整原题、答案、补充和网络来源见D109面试题。

六、个人建议

今天两个坑都值得记：一是「脱敏必须在截断之前」，二是「截断上限要算上你加的提示语」。这两条看起来琐碎，但都是实际报错换来的。另外注意审计表只追加这件事——你以后写测试清理代码时，先想一下这张表允不允许删。面试讲可观测时，不要只说「我们有 Trace」，按 Run→Step→Trace→Event 四层讲一次排查路径，再主动说缺指标和 Eval，比堆名词可信得多。
